label: prf:force-carrier-bring-uniqueness
title: Proof of force carrier bring uniqueness
html:
Proof. The saturation condition selects torus knots whose Seifert genus matches the ambient surface's geometric genus. By the genus-4 uniqueness proposition, the only such torus knots are T_{2,9} (crossing number 9) and T_{3,5} (crossing number 10). \square

Corollary (categorical complexity of the force-carrier sector). Working over R = \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}, (q - q^{-1})^{-1}], the categorical q-dimensions assigned to the two force-carrier objects are \dim_q T_{2,9} = [9]_q and \dim_q T_{3,5} = [10]_q (the q-deformed crossing numbers). The total complexity of the force-carrier sector is

  \dim_q\bigl(T_{2,9}\bigr)
  \cdot
  \dim_q\bigl(T_{3,5}\bigr)
  \;=\;
  [9]_q \cdot [10]_q \,\in\, R.
